title.zh: How the Clarity Act's Defeat Handed the SEC and CFTC the Wheel on Crypto
title.en: How the Clarity Act's Defeat Handed the SEC and CFTC the Wheel on Crypto

current_state.zh: The Senate's rejection of the Clarity Act has prompted the SEC and CFTC to take unilateral regulatory actions on crypto, marking a shift in policy momentum from Congress to federal agencies.
current_state.en: The Senate's rejection of the Clarity Act has prompted the SEC and CFTC to take unilateral regulatory actions on crypto, marking a shift in policy momentum from Congress to federal agencies.
